title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
purpose: Partial fit: the front-end, database and tooling keywords are supported, but Node.js, GraphQL and Terraform are absent from the sample profile.
description:
About the role
Marlowe Finch Logistics makes route-planning software for regional delivery fleets. We need a Full-Stack Software Engineer to build customer-facing web features across our TypeScript stack.

Responsibilities
- Build responsive web features with React and TypeScript
- Design and operate Node.js services and GraphQL APIs
- Model and query data in PostgreSQL
- Write unit tests and integration tests, and take part in code review
- Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS with Terraform

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong React and TypeScript skills
- Production experience with Node.js
- Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database
- Experience writing unit tests
- Experience with Docker

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with GraphQL
- Experience with Terraform
- Experience with AWS
- Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions
